tables.name: Magic Shop
tables.description: The Magic priority's free magic shop.

results.name: Magic Shop - Armor
results.description: (Exotic) Sells magical items with a focus on armor and protective equipment.

results.name: Magic Shop - Books
results.description: (Exotic) Sells magical items with a focus on literature, arcane tomes and lore.

results.name: Magic Shop - Clothing
results.description: (Exotic) Sells magical items with a focus on clothing of all types which bear magical properties.

results.name: Magic Shop - Jewelry
results.description: (Exotic) Sells magical items with a focus on enchanted, or otherwise magically imbued, jewelry.

results.name: Magic Shop - Weapons
results.description: (Exotic) Sells magical items with a focus on weapons with mystic properties and, perhaps, shields.

results.name: Magic Shop - Miscellaneous & Curiosities
results.description: (Exotic) Procures and sells magical items with a focus on strange and rare artifacts of a wondrous or intriguing nature.
